model.description: the name the server answers with: TandemLLM with the conductor configured, else --served-model

base_model.description: the base engine's own name (--served-model), a hidden alias of TandemLLM when the conductor is configured

weights.description: the weight profile (ops/profiles/<name>.env): name, format, weights, hf_repo, drafters, draft_head, sample_nucleus; hf_revision (a branch of the repo) and max_window (the registry's largest window for the profile, null when it fits none; VIS-95) only where the profile has them; optional

gpu_max_allocated_bytes.description: the allocator's peak since the process started (OPS-47 resets the counter before each prefill to measure it; this keeps the maximum across the resets)

split.description: OPS-41: where the engine's resident set goes, in bytes: the allocator's totals, the named parts read off the objects that hold them (weights, kv_pool, gdn_state, drafter_kv, vision, state_store, resident_prefix), what the allocator holds beyond them (other) and keeps without a tensor (reserve), and the load stages' deltas; with the shared KV pool (0.6.1) kv_pool and drafter_kv are the pages COMMITTED for every slot (named in vmm_parts, outside the allocator), kv_reserved_va their reserved address range (not memory), and allocator reserved + kv_committed + outside = in_use = MemTotal - MemAvailable; null when it could not be read

pinned_cache.description: SRV-335: page cache the engine keeps on purpose (Flash-Next's warm n-gram table), free to the kernel and counted off by every floor check

limits.description: OPS-47: the engine's memory limits (server/memlimits.py view()): one row per serve.env key with its value, where it comes from (serve.env, or the residency document's engine section edited in the dashboard), whether a change applies at the next request or needs a restart (MAX_LEN is locked at 262,144), and what it holds now against its cap (bytes for GiB and MiB keys); the memory policy's report (engine/cache.py Budget: ceiling, peak, slack, the shed counts and log); the last session switch and its re-read cost; the parked session. Null when it could not be read

budget.description: engine/cache.py Budget.report(): the limits in bytes, the allocator's numbers less the decision models, the workspace estimate, counts, the shed log

roles.description: 0.6.1 (server/rolemem.py): the small models beside the engine under memory pressure: each role's state (loaded, unloaded_for_memory, reloading, or its slot's own), the reload policy and the last events; null when it could not be read

caches.description: 1.3: null on the standalone proxy (no engine).

lane.description: 0.3.27-test: short requests in the side lane now (server/preempt.py): served at a safe point of the running generation instead of waiting for the engine

side_lane.description: 0.3.27-test: the side lane's settings and counts (server/preempt.py Lane.report); null when it is off

parallel.description: the engine's sequence slots, the GPU turn, the joint verify rounds and the admission (server/slots.py Pool.report); present only with --parallel N

proxy.description: 1.3: the proxy on this server: `embedded` (the engine's own server with --backends), `standalone` (python -m proxy) or `off` (the engine without --backends, 0.3.41-test: no backends, and /v1/config is a 404), and its backends

max_inflight.description: the cap the user set; null: no limit from the proxy (the default)

engine.description: 1.3, P2 and P3: the backend's own engine at layer L1 (proxy/engines.py), for kinds vllm and sglang; null for every other kind. `metrics` is the state of its /metrics page (ok; off: a 404, SGLang without --enable-metrics; error; unknown before the first read). `figures` come from the pages of the last 5 minutes: the window's first and newest page; a figure the pages cannot give is null, never 0. P6: `layer` is L2 while the plugin inside the engine posts, and `plugin` holds its state.

verified.description: the engine release the name table was checked against

plugin.description: 1.3, P6: the plugin inside the backend's engine (tandemllm-vllm-plugin, tandemllm-sglang-plugin; proxy/collect_api.py), null before its first batch. `state` is `l2` while it posts and `l1_only` after 60 s without a batch (an idle plugin posts every 10 s). `joined` and `approximate` count ledger rows that got the engine's own numbers; `unmatched` rows and items that waited 10 minutes for each other; `untagged` items no proxy request asked for. `last` is the newest scheduler sample, `window` the samples of the last 5 minutes: preemptions (SGLang: retractions), KV evictions, the prefix-cache hit rate (vLLM) and speculation (vLLM per draft position from its per-step counts, SGLang from its own window).

hosts.description: 1.3, P1.5: the machines behind the backends (proxy/hostcollect.py). The first is always this machine (`source` local, with the server's own process and every backend on it); then one per remote collector or node_exporter and DCGM pair a backend names. `processes` is null where the source has no per-process figures (an exporter). Absent with --host-collector off and on older servers.

memory.description: `unified` is true on a GB10 (one pool for CPU and GPU: available_bytes is MemAvailable and the GPU has no memory figure of its own), false with a discrete GPU, null without a GPU source

items.description: the process listening on a backend's port (or the server's own, backend `engine` or `proxy`) and its children. `cpu` is in cores over the last scan; `gpu_memory` says how to read the GPU figure: measured (NVML or nvidia-smi gave bytes; on unified memory they come out of the same pool as the RSS), unified (the driver lists the process but gives no figure), not_reported (no GPU source), none (not on the GPU)

cost.description: what the collector itself costs: CPU milliseconds of the last sample and scan and in total
